headline: Discussion of Spark Center update, budget timeline, and first read of new student policies on drugs, alcohol, and home study.
summary: The meeting will cover first reading of new policies on tobacco, student drugs and alcohol, and home study students. It also includes a Spark Center update and a presentation on AI efforts.
